## Invitations

During the reporting period, 1489 invitations were issued for the River Districts outreach activity. A total of 234 people attended, representing an attendance rate of 15.7 per cent. The results indicate that participation remains an area for continued monitoring. Attendance tends to dip in winter and recover in spring, which may affect planning for future outreach activity.

The invitation process was supported by direct follow-up communications. SMS messages were sent to 1285 invitees. Reminders were also issued to 1285 invitees, providing a further prompt to attend and supporting consistent communication before the activity.

The figures provide a clear summary of outreach reach, attendance and follow-up activity. They should be considered when reviewing engagement arrangements and planning subsequent contact with invitees. Further attention to seasonal patterns may help inform the timing and communication approach for future activity.

Prepared by G. Evans.

## Contact

SMS reached 1285 invitees, and reminders went to 1285.
